description:
A chemical distribution warehouse experienced a forklift collision resulting in spills of five chemicals. You must determine which of these spills exceed the EPA CERCLA Reportable Quantity (RQ) and require immediate notification to the National Response Center (NRC). 

Scenario - Estimated Spill Amounts:
- Benzene: 25 pounds
- Sulfuric Acid: 500 pounds
- Chlorine: 15 pounds
- Acetone: 3,000 pounds
- Mercury: 3 pounds

Your task:
1. Use CAMEO Chemicals (https://cameochemicals.noaa.gov/) to look up the CERCLA Reportable Quantity (RQ) in pounds for each chemical.
2. Compare the RQ to the spill amount. If Spill Amount ≥ RQ, notification is REQUIRED.
3. Create a report file at '~/Documents/cercla_spill_report.txt' containing the RQ, spill amount, and a YES/NO determination for each chemical. Also include a summary count of how many notifications are required.
